## Problem / motivation

What are you trying to do, and why is it hard or impossible today?

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to see. If you can, note which layer/package it touches
(see the layer map in the README).

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about.

## Additional context

LoopPlane is spec-first: for larger changes, a short spec under `specs/` may be
requested before implementation. Mentioning the rough scope here helps.
